column1: # Cipher runs of "List zaszyfrowany", Biblioteka Kórnicka BK 1560 (WBC edition 343124), DjVu pages 065-067.
# Transcribed here from the scans, 28 Sept 2026. One row per cipher run.
# Columns: folio  tokens  interlinear gloss (contemporary hand, brown ink; "-" = none)  note
# Tokens: two-digit numbers are cipher; lower-case letters and "us", "ens" etc. are clear endings the writer left
# uncoded; a three-digit number is a code group. "?" marks a doubtful digit.
